answer: The beacon assignment is published and mirror records each panel. The grading quorum of 6 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so a hostile operator cannot sit on the panel that judges it. Shards are assigned from the spiral graph, and thus cluster membership directly reduces grading power. A farm of 1355 identities would post 3687 proofs and burn roughly 53 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
